ClientHeader.description: The calling client and its version, `<cli|console|mcp|node|python>/<version>`; a version listed as faulty answers `E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED`.

Error.description: The one error shape: a context-free code from the catalog, one sentence of what happened and what to do, and the field, rule and target of a failed validation in `details`.

info.title: HotCodePush API
info.description: The HotCodePush REST API for the CLI, the console, the MCP server and your own scripts. Authenticate with an API token from the console as a bearer. The API is still in development: until we declare it stable, breaking changes can happen, each announced in the changelog.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Accepts an invitation with the token from its mail; the caller's address must be the invited one, and the membership counts against the members limit.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

parameters.description: Makes the request safe to retry: the same key with the same body within 24 hours answers the first response again and creates nothing, the same key with another body is refused with `E_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`. A key is scoped to the caller.

patch.description: Changes a member's role; the role the member has already answers the member unchanged. Setting `owner` transfers ownership: only the Owner may, they become Admin in the same transaction, and the organization keeps exactly one Owner.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

delete.description: Removes a member; removing others needs Admin or Owner, and any member deletes their own row to leave. The Owner leaves only after transferring ownership.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

get.description: The organization's SSO provider: its kind, domain, whether the domain is verified, the sign-in link, and the TXT record to set until it is.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

put.description: Sets the OIDC or SAML provider and its domain, replacing the one before; one per organization, paying plans only. A new or changed domain starts unverified, with the TXT record to set in the answer.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

delete.description: Removes the SSO provider: password sign-in works again for its members, and the domain is forgotten.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Checks the domain's TXT record for the token the provider waits for and marks the domain verified when it is there; the answer is the provider, its `isVerified` the result. A resolver that cannot be asked leaves the domain unverified, `details.reason` then `lookup_failed`.

200.description: The provider, verified or still waiting for the record.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Creates an organization; the creator becomes its Owner.

parameters.description: Makes the request safe to retry: the same key with the same body within 24 hours answers the first response again and creates nothing, the same key with another body is refused with `E_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`. A key is scoped to the caller.

204.description: The organization is scheduled for deletion.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

get.description: The app's uploaded bundles, newest first; the store builds' embedded bundles are listed under embedded-bundles. `isInUse` selects the bundles an active or paused release serves.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Creates the bundle from its manifest — platforms, version label, files with path, hash and size, fingerprint, git provenance — and answers the hashes the app lacks with their upload URLs; the bundle is `uploading` until completed.

parameters.description: Makes the request safe to retry: the same key with the same body within 24 hours answers the first response again and creates nothing, the same key with another body is refused with `E_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`. A key is scoped to the caller.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

get.description: One bundle, with the derived expiry — `unusedSince` plus the retention — while it is in use nowhere.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

delete.description: Deletes the bundle now, not by retention: refused while a release serves it or a store build registered it as its embedded bundle; its manifest, pack and delta packs go with it, and the files no other bundle of the app lists.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

put.description: The full pack, one per bundle, streamed under its prefix; `Content-Length` declares the bytes.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

put.description: The delta pack from a base bundle of the app, streamed under the bundle's prefix; `Content-Length` declares the bytes.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Starts a multipart upload of the full pack, for a pack above the request body limit; the parts follow, and the single PUT stays for small packs.

201.description: The upload id the parts carry.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

put.description: One part of a multipart upload, its bytes as the body and `Content-Length` their count; every part but the last is at least five mebibytes, all are of one size, and an upload has at most 10,000.

200.description: The part, to hand back at completion.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Assembles the parts into the full pack and counts its bytes, as the single PUT does; a pack uploaded before is replaced, and one above the byte limit is deleted.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

delete.description: Aborts a multipart pack upload, discarding its parts.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Starts a multipart upload of the delta pack from a base bundle of the app, for a delta pack above the request body limit; the parts follow, and the single PUT stays for small ones.

201.description: The upload id the parts carry.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Assembles the parts into the delta pack and counts its bytes, as the single PUT does; a delta pack uploaded before is replaced, and one above the byte limit is deleted.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Verifies every listed file, the pack and the delta packs are present, writes the manifest envelope at the bundle's key and sets `ready`; a completed bundle answers itself again.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

get.description: The app's channels, newest first.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Creates a channel: the name is one to 64 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores and unique per app; only Owners and Admins protect one; an expiry never sits on a protected channel; the count is bounded by `channels_per_app_limit`.

parameters.description: Makes the request safe to retry: the same key with the same body within 24 hours answers the first response again and creates nothing, the same key with another body is refused with `E_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`. A key is scoped to the caller.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

patch.description: Edits the name, the protected and discoverable flags, the expiry and the auto-pause policy; every change to a protected channel is Admin or Owner, and the expiry is refused on the default channel.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

delete.description: Deletes the channel with its releases: it leaves the frontier and starts its bundles' retention clocks; refused on the app's default channel.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: A paused channel serves nothing new: its index carries `isPaused` and devices keep what they have — the kill switch for a whole channel.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: The channel serves its frontier again.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

get.description: The channel's release log, newest first, each release with the devices whose current release it is; `?relations=channel,bundle,counters` embeds the linked rows.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

get.summary: List the releases of a channel

post.description: Creates a release of a ready bundle in the channel with its conditions, rollout, mandatory flag and notes, numbered next in the channel; refused on a protected channel below Admin and past `releases_per_app_per_day_limit`; an `Idempotency-Key` answers the same release again for 24 hours.

parameters.description: Makes the request safe to retry: the same key with the same body within 24 hours answers the first response again and creates nothing, the same key with another body is refused with `E_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`. A key is scoped to the caller.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Creates a release of the channel's previous bundle, or of the release named by `toReleaseId`, with the rollback recorded as its provenance; a rollback is a release, never a mutation.

parameters.description: Makes the request safe to retry: the same key with the same body within 24 hours answers the first response again and creates nothing, the same key with another body is refused with `E_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`. A key is scoped to the caller.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

Create-only on the identity: an identical re-registration answers the row, a conflicting fingerprint is refused, and `force` updates it.

parameters.description: Makes the request safe to retry: the same key with the same body within 24 hours answers the first response again and creates nothing, the same key with another body is refused with `E_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`. A key is scoped to the caller.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: The registration, unchanged or updated with `force`.

put.description: Uploads one file of the web build: the body is the file gzip-compressed, `Content-Length` its size, and the path the SHA-256 of the uncompressed content, checked as the bytes pass; a hash the app already holds answers the existing file.

400.description: E_HASH_MISMATCH or E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

200.description: The part, to hand back at completion.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Assembles the parts, checks the assembled size against the byte limit and the content's hash by one streamed read; a refusal leaves nothing behind.

400.description: E_HASH_MISMATCH or E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

patch.description: Edits the rollout percentage in both directions — a device that has the release keeps it — the mandatory flag and the notes; the index re-materializes and devices see the change on their next check; revoked is terminal.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Stops offering the release; devices on it keep it. Admin or Owner on a protected channel.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: Offers the release again and starts a new auto-pause window. Admin or Owner on a protected channel.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

post.description: The release is dead: devices on it move to the newest eligible older release or the embedded bundle. Admin or Owner on a protected channel; revoked is terminal.

400.description: E_VALIDATION, with the field, the rule and the target in `details`, or E_CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED

patch.description: Edits the name, the default channel or the deep-link template behind the QR surfaces; the template is a URI with a scheme and `{channelId}` exactly once.
